summary_text: Across 12 independent dates in June 2026, the user placed orders on weekdays (morning, afternoon, night) and weekends (morning, afternoon). Vegetables were present in every order, often in large quantities or multiple SKUs, indicating a consistent need for fresh produce. Diapers appeared in 4 independent orders (06-04, 06-10, 06-17, 06-23, 06-27), establishing a recurring household need. Milk and Curd Yogurt appeared in multiple orders (06-11, 06-17, 06-25, 06-27), suggesting regular dairy consumption. Baby Cereal was purchased on 3 independent dates (06-04, 06-11, 06-25). Fruits appeared in 3 independent dates (06-03, 06-04, 06-27). Aerated Drinks appeared in 4 independent dates (06-07, 06-11, 06-15, 06-25, 06-27). The combination of Diapers and Vegetables was observed on 5 independent dates. The combination of Milk and Vegetables was observed on 3 independent dates. The combination of Curd Yogurt and Vegetables was observed on 3 independent dates. The combination of Fruits and Vegetables was observed on 3 independent dates. The combination of Baby Cereal and Vegetables was observed on 3 independent dates. The combination of Diaper and Vegetables is the most frequent cross-category pair. Shopping needs center on household replenishment, fresh meal preparation, and baby care.
